videos.title: Jersey
videos.description: Struggling to make ends meet, a former cricketer must decide whether to return to the sport he loves to fulfil his son's wish for a jersey.

videos.title: Bareilly Ki Barfi
videos.description: Set in the small town of Bareilly, Bitti is a free-spirited young girl who lives life on her own terms and refuses to be pressured into getting married. Her life takes a shift when she meets Chirag Dubey and Pritam Vidrohi.

videos.title: Hero
videos.description: A barber's decision to take revenge on his ex-girlfriend turns adventurous after he realises that her husband is a notorious gangster.

videos.title: Hamari Adhuri Kahani
videos.description: A young woman begins a promising romance with a hotel tycoon. Everything seems to be going well, until the shadows of the past return to haunt the protagonist.

videos.title: Murder 2
videos.description: A former police officer gets hired by a gangster to trace a group of missing call girls and their abductor.

videos.title: Hum Aapke Hain Koun!
videos.description: A man and woman meet and fall in love at the wedding of their elder siblings, but their plans to be together are put in jeopardy when her sister dies, leaving behind a baby.

videos.title: Jism
videos.description: Kabir, an alcoholic lawyer, falls in love with Sonia, the wife of a travelling millionaire, who convinces him to murder her husband. However, Kabir is shocked when he discovers Sonia's true motive for the murder.

videos.title: Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan
videos.description: For the longest time, Bhaijaan put his brothers first and committed himself to the life of a bachelor. Yet, things change when he falls in love with Bhagyalakshmi and renounces violence just as gangsters target the family's colony.

videos.title: No Entry
videos.description: A gorgeous club dancer's ill-timed rendezvous opens up a Pandora's box of lies, absurdities and misunderstandings in the lives of three quirky couples.

videos.title: Bhooth Bangla
videos.description: A man plans his sister's wedding in a palace that he inherits in rural Mangalpur. Supernatural events and scared locals force him to investigate the mysterious past of his property.

videos.title: English Vinglish
videos.description: While taking a spoken English crash course in New York, a mild-mannered Indian housewife develops a stronger personality and builds several meaningful friendships.

videos.title: Zeher
videos.description: A Police Inspector is married to her subordinate, and both are employed by the Goa Police Force. They share a fairly harmonious relationship until a woman goes missing and is believed dead. To add to the mystery, there is also the question of a missing suitcase full of cash.

videos.title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
videos.description: A family film about the trials and challenges of a joint family in India, starring Salman Khan, Saif Ali Khan, Karisma Kapoor.

videos.title: Sholay
videos.description: The tale of one man's fight for justice. In an act of retribution, cold-blooded criminal Gabbar Singh massacres the family of a police officer, Thakur Baldev. Left crippled by his enemy, Thakur is hungry for revenge but, seeing no way of bringing Gabbar to book, he hires two petty crooks, Veeru and Jai.

videos.title: Rehnaa Hai Terre Dil Mein
videos.description: Maddy has seven days to win Reena's affections before she finds out that he is not Rajeev, the childhood friend and prospective fiancé she has been expecting.

videos.title: Pure Bollywood
videos.description: A comprehensive compilation of some of the best foot-tapping and popular songs from Bollywood is played back to back to entertain the audience.

videos.title: Prem
videos.description: Sanjay has visions of his past life and when he sees Sonia, he is convinced that they were lovers. Will Sonia get convinced?

videos.title: Kalyug
videos.description: A couple's marital bliss is shattered when a group of people film and upload a video of them being intimate on an adult website. The husband fights to take them and their illegal racket down.

videos.title: Baby John
videos.description: DCP Satya Verma fakes his own death to protect his daughter from the dangerous politician Babbar Sher. When old enemies resurface, Satya must confront his past and put everything on the line to safeguard his family.

videos.title: Bobby
videos.description: An intimate portrait of the life and career of Bobby Moore, the man who captained England to victory in the 1966 World Cup, featuring interviews with those closest to him.

videos.title: Awarapan
videos.description: A hitman falls in love with a devout Muslim woman who opens his eyes to compassion and the teachings of Prophet Muhammad.

videos.title: Udta Punjab
videos.description: The insurgence of substance abuse among the young in the Indian state of Punjab through the stories of a rock star, a migrant labourer, a doctor and a policeman.

videos.title: Aparichit - The Stranger
videos.description: Ramanujam, a lawyer with multiple personalities, turns vigilante at night. Guided by Garuda Purana, he hunts down criminals and exposes anti-social elements in society.
